architecture.source: assumption: the published Qwen3.5 (GGUF family qwen35) hybrid layout; not in the recorded /api/tags metadata

limits: block, head and head-size counts are assumed (not recorded); a different layout changes the KV cache
compute-graph and CUDA-context sizes are allowances, not derived; flash attention and the server's own memory estimate are not known offline
Ollama decides the GPU/CPU split itself at load time; only /api/ps after the warm-up shows it
note: OFFLINE ESTIMATE from recorded metadata only; no Ollama call; the runtime check full-gpu-v1 (size_vram == size at warm-up) is decisive
reading: the dev-c6 qwen run at num_ctx 8192 generated at 65.3 tokens/s median (min 50.9) over 107 turns, a rate that reads every weight from VRAM for each token; a split with CPU layers would be bounded by host-memory bandwidth for its share. An inference that 8192 ran fully on the GPU, not a measurement (dev-c6 recorded no /api/ps after its load).

server.kv_cache_type: f16 (OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE unset in the ollama-prime HelmRelease)
server.parallel_note: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL unset in the HelmRelease; one slot assumed (a second slot would double the KV cache)
